_comment: Single source of truth for what a release is built from. Scripts and workflows read
their pins from here; nothing is pinned anywhere else. A bump is an edit here only.
ell, iwd      upstream release: built from the kernel.org tarball (tarball, with the
version in place of {v}), checked against its .sign with keys/; the
tag's commit is recorded for reference. debian = the Debian packaging
we build with (salsa.debian.org, pinned by commit)
iwd.revision (optional) replaces deb.revision for iwd: a
pre-release (D20), or an iwd that carries our patches (D21)
backport      backport-iwlwifi release branch and the commit we build;
backport.revision (optional) replaces deb.revision for the driver
package: a pre-release (D20), or a driver whose patches changed (D9)
firmware      linux-firmware commit and the AX210 files taken from it; release is
the backport release the firmware drop was made for, for humans
l4t           the Jetson Linux line we support. headers lists NVIDIA's
nvidia-l4t-kernel-headers packages (from repo) CI test-compiles the driver against;
container is the Ubuntu image the debs are built in (index digest)
deb           revision is appended to the Debian version of every deb we build;
maintainer is the Maintainer they carry
The newest backport branch is not the highest number: core24.70 (2026-09) is newer
than core105 (2026-05). A new release/core* branch is a PR, never an automerge.
